function.name: LOAD_SONG
function.abstract: It recovers of disk any music archive

description.p:
Open a music archive from disk, to play after with . Actually the supported formats are the following:
OGG Vorbis (.ogg): Recommended for his excelent quality. An archive .ogg holds a digital recording of sound, high compressed. If you want to use recorded music, this is the best format.
MIDI (.mid): Recommended for the low size that it takes in disk. An archive .mid only holds a representation of the notes that form the music, and the soundcard will have the reproduction of the instruments. If you want to create games that it takes low size in disk, it is the best format.
Modules (.xm, .it, .s3m, .mod): This modules hold a representation of the notes that form the music and the digital instruments used. It is an intermediate format to both, it has a medium quality and size.
WAV (.wav): WAV archives hold a digital recording but take high size in disk. Use it only if you want to play environmental or background sound instead of music.
This function returns an entire number that identifies the music, or -1 if the music archive is not a valid format. You can use the returned value to play music by the function .
